🔧 Instructions for Failure Analysis

A trained cold chain equipment technician—or another trained and qualified assessor—should complete this procedure and use this tool to:

  • Record observed failure(s), including the specific component(s) and suspected cause(s)
  • Log any relevant performance data required during the assessment
  • Note any additional observations that may assist in evaluating equipment status

Please note: The detailed survey questions are provided to support troubleshooting and do not need to be completed in full. Use them as a reference and document only the data that helps with diagnosing or recording the issue.

🔌 Power Supply System

This section includes questions Q1–Q16 about the power supply system.

🔌 Power Supply System

Use this and the following sections to enter physical data and observations taken while troubleshooting the failure. You do not need to fill in each field, only those that you observe or record while troubleshooting.
1. AC voltage as measured (volts)
2. AC frequency as measured (Hz)
3. Appliance AC voltage requirement (volts)
4. Appliance AC frequency requirement (Hz)
5. LED diagnostic result (if applicable)
6. Voltage stabilizer AC voltage as measured (volts)
7. Wall power outlet AC voltage as measured (volts)
8. DC voltage as measured (volts)
9. Appliance DC voltage requirement (volts)
10. Open circuit voltage (volts)
11. Irradiance at solar array (W/m2)
12. Soiling severity of solar panels
13. Current orientation of solar array
14. Optimal orientation of solar array
15. Current tilt of the solar array, measured from the horizontal (°)
16. Optimal tilt of the solar array, measured from the horizontal (°)

🌡️ Thermostat, Controls & Monitoring System

This section include questions Q17–Q24 about the thermostat, controls, and monitoring systems.

🌡️ Thermostat, Controls & Monitoring System

Use this and the following sections to enter physical data and observations taken while troubleshooting the failure. You do not need to fill in each field, only those that you observe or record while troubleshooting.
17. Thermocouple reading at thermostat sensor location (°C)
18. Thermostat setpoint (°C or set position)
19. Thermostat sensor: Location
20. Thermostat sensor: Exposure to condensation buildup
21. Thermostat sensor: Airflow
22. Thermocouple reading at external display sensor location (°C)
23. External display temperature reading (°C)
24. Thermocouple reading in center of compartment (°C)

❄️ Cooling Circuit

This section includes questions Q25-Q26 about the cooling circuit.

❄️ Cooling Circuit

Use this and the following sections to enter physical data and observations taken while troubleshooting the failure. You do not need to fill in each field, only those that you observe or record while troubleshooting.
25. Fan issues observed

constraint_message.text: Other field is empty. Please specify.

prompt.text: 26. Compressor discharge pipe temperature (°C)

🧲 Seals and Closure

This section cover questions Q27-30 about seals and closures.

🧲 Seals and Closure

Use this and the following sections to enter physical data and observations taken while troubleshooting the failure. You do not need to fill in each field, only those that you observe or record while troubleshooting.
27. Are any gaps through which air could escape noticeable between the cabinet and the gasket on the door/lid?
28. Describe any gasket damage/deterioration (including tears, missing pieces, deadhesion, looseness, wetness, or mold).
29. Gap offset (mm)
30. Describe any physical degradation of the hinges observed (including corrosion, cracking, or broken hinges).

🧊 Thermal Storage

This section covers the components responsible for thermal storage from Q31-32.

🧊 Thermal Storage

Use this and the following sections to enter physical data and observations taken while troubleshooting the failure. You do not need to fill in each field, only those that you observe or record while troubleshooting.
31. Is the thermal storage (e.g. ice liner) in good condition and in place?
32. What is wrong with the thermal storage?

📦 Casing and Storage Compartment

This section focuses on inspecting the physical casing and internal storage areas of the equipment in Q33.

📦 Casing and Storage Compartment

Use this and the following sections to enter physical data and observations taken while troubleshooting the failure. You do not need to fill in each field, only those that you observe or record while troubleshooting.
33. Depth of condensation buildup (cm)

🌍 Location and External Environment

This section assesses the placement of the equipment and its surrounding conditions in Q 34-35.

🌍 Location and External Environment

Use this and the following sections to enter physical data and observations taken while troubleshooting the failure. You do not need to fill in each field, only those that you observe or record while troubleshooting.
34. Ambient temperature (°C)
35. Relative humidity (%)
🚨 Failure Reporting

📝 Non-Failure Observations

Enter any issues or concerns noted with the appliance that are not failures.
Survey completed.  Pressing NEXT will save and exit.
